title: Product Change and Repair Report
transcript:
Speaker 1: Man: Hello, Cozy House Home Appliance, this is sales representative Mike speaking, how may I help you?
Speaker 2: Woman: Hello, I bought a vacuum cleaner last month, but it doesn’t work as well as I expected, I am considering returning it.
Speaker 1: Man: Okay, first I need to get a few details about this item, can you give me your name, please?
Speaker 2: Woman: Yes, it’s Dinane Ruddick.
Speaker 1: Man: It’s R-U-D-D-I-C-K, right?
Speaker 2: Woman: Yes, that’s right.
Speaker 1: Man: Could you tell me your mobile number?
Speaker 2: Woman: It’s 4-5 double 6-3-2-1, and that’s my home number.
Speaker 1: Man: Got it, and your address, please?
Speaker 2: Woman: It’s No.42, Garden Avenue.
Speaker 1: Man: Right, now I need some information about the product. Do you remember when exactly you bought it last month?
Speaker 2: Woman: Um, let me see, there was a promotion from 26th July to 31st July, and I made the purchase on the last day.
Speaker 1: Man: Okay, now I need to take down a few details about the problem, is it the noise too loud or it’s broken?
Speaker 2: Woman: Not really, the problem lies in the handle. After I used the cleaner twice, I noticed that the handle often falls off if I use over 20 minutes. It’s just dangerous, I don’t want to get hurt. Besides, the buttons on the handle, they are not in good condition. Last night, I pressed all of them, but nothing happened. I highly doubt the quality of the item!
!
Speaker 1: Man: Okay. I will make a note of that and we will see what we can do. Now I need one more thing, how much did you pay when you bought it? You mentioned you made the purchase during the promotion, right?
Speaker 2: Woman: Yeah, that’s right. I still got the invoice, let me check, oh, its original price was $154, but I only paid $104 for that.
Speaker 1: Man: Okay, according to what we have talked about just now, I suggest we repair the handle and it’s totally free.
Speaker 2: Woman: I don’t think this is a minor problem that can be fixed. I’m quite disappointed with the vacuum cleaner.
Speaker 1: Man: Umm, recently we have a new type available, if you are interested..., I can apply for some kind of discount for you.
Speaker 2: Woman: That works for me. Could you tell me more about the new model?
Speaker 1: Man: Yeah, of course, this model has a reusable bag, so you needn’t buy loads of plastic bags, and it’s more environmentally friendly.
Speaker 2: Woman: Yeah, that’s really an advantage for me. Hum, I guess it will be much more expensive than the one I already got, right?
Speaker 1: Man: Well, it can be a little bit expensive, but not that much, it’s $290 now, and the price will probably go up next month. But in your case, it’ll be $190.
Speaker 2: Woman: Ok, that’s acceptable, as long as it falls into the range of $100 to $200, but I can’t go beyond $200.
Speaker 1: Man: Great, then which color do you prefer? We have got red, pink and erm... sky blue and...
Speaker 2: Woman: Do you have purple or silver?
Speaker 1: Man: Yeah, I guess so, but you will have to wait several days for the model with both colors.
Speaker 2: Woman: No problem, as long as it’s not a broken one, I will go for purple.
